\caption{Identifiability}

            \begin{algorithmic}[1]
                \STATE \textbf{Function ID}($\mathbf{X},\mathbf{Y},\mathcal{G}$)
                \STATE \textbf{Output:} True, if the causal effect of $\mathbf{X}$ on $\mathbf{Y}$ is identifiable from $\mathcal{G}$.
